lines.text: Many learners say: She is married with a doctor.
Better: She is married to a doctor.
To! He is married to my sister.

data.wrong: She is married with a doctor.
data.right: She is married to a doctor.

native.tip: Замужем или женат — всегда “married to”, а не “with”.
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “She is married with a doctor.”? 😅 По-русски «замужем за», а по-английски “married to”, не “with”. Правильно: “She is married to a doctor.”. Послушай Карлос и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “to”. После married ставим to. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.caption: Do you also say “She is married with a doctor.”? 😅 In Russian it is “zamuzhem za”, but in English it is “married to”, not “with”. Correct: “She is married to a doctor.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
